content.text: {"candidates":[{"id":"E16","hypothesis_id":"H03","title":"Amine omission and bounded inert-base replacement","purpose":"Test whether amine presence is necessary in the P01 TEA/TEOA comparison and whether a tightly screened non-donor base can produce only limited medium-related shifts, without treating it as an amine surrogate or proof of proton-management causality.","evidence_ids":["EV013","EV024","GX010","GX015","GX008"],"source_to_proposal":"EV013 supports treating TEA and TEOA as multifunctional additives that can act as H+ source and hole scavenger, so omission is required before interpreting additive identity effects. EV024, GX010, and GX015 support the narrower transferable idea that proton-delivery environment can alter CO2-reduction behavior, which justifies a bounded non-donor-base probe. GX008 supports matched negative controls and broad product analysis. Transfer remains limited because no supplied evidence shows that a non-donor base reproduces the sacrificial-donor role in the target Co-bpy photocatalysis; therefore any shift with base addition is only descriptive evidence for medium contribution.","groups":[{"id":"E16G01","description":"Primary TEOA baseline in the stated P01 Co-bpy/g-C3N4 assay.","factors":[{"name":"platform","value":"P01 CoCl2 + 2,2'-bipyridine + g-C3N4 in MeCN/H2O under CO2 and light"},{"name":"amine_condition","value":"TEOA present"},{"name":"base_condition","value":"none"},{"name":"gas_atmosphere","value":"CO2"},{"name":"illumination","value":"on"}]},{"id":"E16G02","description":"Amine omission control with baseline otherwise retained.","factors":[{"name":"platform","value":"P01 CoCl2 + 2,2'-bipyridine + g-C3N4 in MeCN/H2O under CO2 and light"},{"name":"amine_condition","value":"none"},{"name":"base_condition","value":"none"},{"name":"gas_atmosphere","value":"CO2"},{"name":"illumination","value":"on"}]},{"id":"E16G03","description":"No amine plus one pre-screened non-donor base chosen only if it shows low blank reactivity and acceptable mixture compatibility.","factors":[{"name":"platform","value":"P01 CoCl2 + 2,2'-bipyridine + g-C3N4 in MeCN/H2O under CO2 and light"},{"name":"amine_condition","value":"none"},{"name":"base_condition","value":"pre-screened non-donor base present"},{"name":"gas_atmosphere","value":"CO2"},{"name":"illumination","value":"on"}]},{"id":"E16G04","description":"TEA comparator under the same platform.","factors":[{"name":"platform","value":"P01 CoCl2 + 2,2'-bipyridine + g-C3N4 in MeCN/H2O under CO2 and light"},{"name":"amine_condition","value":"TEA present"},{"name":"base_condition","value":"none"},{"name":"gas_atmosphere","value":"CO2"},{"name":"illumination","value":"on"}]}],"comparisons":[{"group_a":"E16G01","group_b":"E16G02","changed_factors":["amine_condition"],"inference":"Omission test for whether an amine is required under the TEOA baseline; it does not separate donor redox, proton-management, and solvation roles."},{"group_a":"E16G02","group_b":"E16G03","changed_factors":["base_condition"],"inference":"Tests whether a carefully screened non-donor base causes any reproducible shift relative to no amine; any rescue is bounded evidence for medium contribution only, not amine equivalence."},{"group_a":"E16G01","group_b":"E16G04","changed_factors":["amine_condition"],"inference":"Direct TEA versus TEOA comparison within one platform; remains a multifunctional additive identity contrast rather than a single-mechanism causal test."},{"group_a":"E16G03","group_b":"E16G04","changed_factors":["amine_condition","base_condition"],"inference":"Confounded descriptive contrast only; do not use it to rank mechanisms beyond bounding whether some behavior can be approached without an amine donor."}],"procedure":["Verify the P01 baseline composition from the supplied scope, then perform a short pilot screen of candidate non-donor bases in the same solvent matrix using blank-reactivity and compatibility checks before selecting at most one replacement condition.","Prepare the listed groups with identical catalyst, ligand, g-C3N4, solvent ratio, reactor geometry, CO2 handling, irradiation schedule, and analytical workflow; vary only the stated factors.","Run photocatalysis under CO2 with matched sampling and quantify both CO and H2 for every group using one calibrated gas-analysis workflow.","Record a bulk acid-base descriptor in the chosen medium if measurable, and note visible precipitation, turbidity, color change, or phase instability as comparability flags.","If no non-donor base passes pilot criteria, execute only the omission and TEA/TEOA arms and report the replacement arm as blocked rather than forcing interpretation."],"measurements":["CO amount or rate by the common gas-analysis workflow","H2 amount or rate by the same workflow","CO/H2 ratio or selectivity metric derived from paired CO and H2 data","Bulk acid-base descriptor before and after reaction if measurable in the chosen medium","Qualitative observations of precipitation, turbidity, color change, or phase separation as comparability checks"],"supports":"H03 is supported only in a limited sense if amine omission strongly suppresses or shifts the baseline behavior and the pre-screened non-donor base causes a reproducible partial movement in activity or CO/H2 distribution relative to no amine, while TEA and TEOA still differ under matched conditions.","refutes":"H03 is weakened if the non-donor base produces no reproducible shift relative to no amine and TEA versus TEOA differences remain large under otherwise matched conditions, especially if omission mainly removes activity in a manner consistent with loss of sacrificial-donor function alone.","inconclusive":"Inconclusive if the selected base introduces background reactivity, coordination changes, instability, or phase changes; if bulk acid-base comparison is not meaningful in the medium; or if CO and H2 signals are near detection limits.","parameter_selection":"Do not invent concentrations. Use the verified P01 baseline for TEA and TEOA conditions. For the replacement arm, screen candidate non-donor bases in the same solvent matrix and select one only if it satisfies all pilot criteria: negligible CO and H2 in catalyst-free or no-light blanks, no obvious decomposition or precipitation before irradiation, and a measurable change in a bulk acid-base descriptor relative to E16G02. If no candidate satisfies these criteria, retain only E16G01, E16G02, and E16G04.","limitations":"The replacement arm remains intrinsically limited because a non-donor base cannot reproduce sacrificial electron donation. Any observed rescue can also arise from coordination, ionic-strength, viscosity, or solvation changes. Failure to rescue does not exclude proton-management contributions. Bulk acid-base descriptors in MeCN/H2O may not represent local proton delivery. This card therefore tests necessity plus bounded medium sensitivity, not full causal separation.","feasibility":"low_cost"}]}
